questions.subject: discrete-mathematics
questions.html:
Consider the statement: “If n is divisible by 30 then n is divisible by 2 and by 3 and by 5.” Which statement is equivalent?

(A) If n is not divisible by 30 then n is divisible by 2 or by 3 or by 5.
(B) If n is not divisible by 30 then n is not divisible by 2 or not by 3 or not by 5.
(C) If n is divisible by 2, 3 and 5 then n is divisible by 30.
(D) If n is not divisible by 2 or not by 3 or not by 5 then n is not divisible by 30.
(E) If n is divisible by 2 or by 3 or by 5 then n is divisible by 30.
